metadata.name: PROD/crm-deployment
metadata.originalYamlString:
version: "1.0"
kind: pipeline
metadata:
  name: PROD/crm-deployment
  project: PROD
  labels:
    tags:
      - production
      - crm

spec:
  stages:
    - prepare
    - build
    - test
    - staging
    - production
    - notify

  steps:

    # ── PREPARE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    set_default_variables:
      title: Set Default Variables
      stage: prepare
      type: freestyle
      image: alpine:3.18
      commands:
        - cf_export IMAGE_TAG=${CF_SHORT_REVISION:-latest}
        - cf_export ECR_REPO=123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/crm-app
        - cf_export CLUSTER_NAME=prod-eks-cluster
        - cf_export HELM_RELEASE_NAME=crm

    aws_oidc_authoriser:
      title: AWS OIDC Authoriser
      stage: prepare
      type: freestyle
      image: amazon/aws-cli:2.15.0
      environment:
        - AWS_ROLE_ARN=${{AWS_OIDC_ROLE_ARN}}
        - AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE=/var/run/secrets/oidc/token
      commands:
        - aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity
            --role-arn $AWS_ROLE_ARN
            --role-session-name codefresh-ci
            --web-identity-token file://$AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE
            --duration-seconds 3600
            --output json > /tmp/aws-creds.json
        - export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId /tmp/aws-creds.json)
        - cf_export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
        - cf_export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey /tmp/aws-creds.json)
        - cf_export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken /tmp/aws-creds.json)

    git_clone:
      title: Clone Repository
      stage: prepare
      type: git-clone
      repo: myorg/crm-app
      revision: ${{CF_REVISION}}
      git: github-connection

    # ── BUILD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    build_docker_image:
      title: Build Docker Image
      stage: build
      type: build
      image_name: crm-app
      tag: ${{IMAGE_TAG}}
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      build_arguments:
        - NODE_ENV=production
        - APP_VERSION=${{IMAGE_TAG}}
      no_cache: false

    push_to_ecr:
      title: Push to ECR
      stage: build
      type: push
      candidate: ${{build_docker_image}}
      tags:
        - ${{IMAGE_TAG}}
        - latest
      registry: ecr-registry

    # ── TEST ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    run_unit_tests:
      title: Run Unit Tests
      stage: test
      type: freestyle
      image: node:20-alpine
      working_directory: ${{git_clone}}
      commands:
        - npm ci --prefer-offline
        - npm test -- --coverage --ci
        - npm run test:report

    code_quality_scan:
      title: Code Quality Scan
      stage: test
      type: freestyle
      image: sonarsource/sonar-scanner-cli:5
      environment:
        - SONAR_HOST_URL=${{SONAR_HOST_URL}}
        - SONAR_TOKEN=${{SONAR_TOKEN}}
        - SONAR_PROJECT_VERSION=${{IMAGE_TAG}}
      commands:
        - sonar-scanner
            -Dsonar.projectKey=crm-app
            -Dsonar.sources=src
            -Dsonar.tests=test
            -Dsonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths=coverage/lcov.info
            -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true

    integration_tests:
      title: Integration Tests
      stage: test
      type: freestyle
      image: node:20-alpine
      working_directory: ${{git_clone}}
      commands:
        - npm run test:integration -- --baseUrl=${{STAGING_URL}} --reporter=junit
      retry:
        maxAttempts: 3
        delay: 30

    # ── STAGING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    deploy_to_staging:
      title: Deploy to Staging
      stage: staging
      type: deploy
      kind: helm
      helm_version: 3.12.0
      chart_name: charts/crm-app
      release_name: crm-staging
      kube_context: staging-eks-cluster
      namespace: staging
      set:
        - image.tag=${{IMAGE_TAG}}
        - image.repository=${{ECR_REPO}}
        - replicaCount=2

    smoke_tests:
      title: Smoke Tests
      stage: staging
      type: freestyle
      image: postman/newman:6-alpine
      commands:
        - newman run collections/smoke-tests.json
            --env-var BASE_URL=${{STAGING_URL}}
            --env-var API_KEY=${{STAGING_API_KEY}}
            --reporters cli,junit
            --reporter-junit-export results/smoke.xml

    # ── PRODUCTION ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    deploy_to_production:
      title: Deploy to Production
      stage: production
      type: deploy
      kind: helm
      helm_version: 3.12.0
      chart_name: charts/crm-app
      release_name: crm-production
      kube_context: prod-eks-cluster
      namespace: production
      set:
        - image.tag=${{IMAGE_TAG}}
        - image.repository=${{ECR_REPO}}
        - replicaCount=5
      when:
        branch:
          only:
            - main

    # ── NOTIFY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    notify_teams:
      title: Notify Teams Channel
      stage: notify
      type: freestyle
      image: curlimages/curl:8.5.0
      when:
        condition:
          all:
            deploySucceeded: '"${{deploy_to_production.result}}" == "success"'
      commands:
        - |
          curl -s -X POST "${{TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL}}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"text\":\"✅ CRM \`${{IMAGE_TAG}}\` deployed to production by ${{CF_BUILD_INITIATOR}}\"}"

notify_failure.title: Notify on Failure
commands: curl -s -X POST "${{TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL}}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"text\":\"❌ CRM build ${{CF_BUILD_ID}} failed at ${{CF_STEP_NAME}}\"}"

aws_oidc_authoriser.title: AWS OIDC Authoriser
commands: aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn $AWS_ROLE_ARN --role-session-name codefresh-ci --web-identity-token file://$AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE --duration-seconds 3600 --output json > /tmp/aws-creds.json

smoke_tests.title: Smoke Tests
commands: newman run collections/smoke-tests.json --env-var BASE_URL=${{STAGING_URL}} --env-var API_KEY=${{STAGING_API_KEY}} --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export results/smoke.xml

notify_teams.title: Notify Teams Channel
commands: curl -s -X POST "${{TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL}}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"text\":\"✅ CRM `${{IMAGE_TAG}}` deployed to production by ${{CF_BUILD_INITIATOR}}\"}"
